tips: A countermeasure from 5 Whys, a finding from the 5S audit, a signal from the control chart: they all land here with an owner and a date.
A verb, a name and a date. “Improve loading” is a wish; “Anna posts the stacking picture at dock 2 by Friday” is an action.
Done says the change was made. Verified says the number moved and stayed. Only verified closes the loop.
Review it weekly, in ten minutes.
Overdue first, then due this week, then what was verified. The list is the agenda.
Ten open actions nobody closes are worse than three that get verified. Drop or merge what has gone stale.

verdicts.clear: Nothing overdue. The list is under control.
verdicts.some: {n} overdue. Decide today: a new date, a new owner, or drop it.
verdicts.many: {n} overdue. The list has stopped being a plan. Close, merge or drop until what is left is real.
